column3: BSB starts a new sentence (“This salvation was first announced”) and adds “Him.”
BSB renders “distributions of the Holy Spirit” as “gifts of the Holy Spirit distributed.”
BSB renders “someone has testified” as “it is testified in these words.”
BSB follows the critical text without “and set him over the works of your hands,” which the Textus Receptus adds.
BSB adds “God” and renders “unsubject” as “outside of his control.”
BSB adds “now” and renders “because of the suffering of death” as “because He suffered death.”
BSB adds “God” and moves “in bringing many sons to glory” to the front; “author” renders “archetype/founder.”
BSB renders “of one” as “of the same family” and adds “Jesus.”
BSB renders “the same things” as “their humanity.”
BSB renders “to make propitiation” as “to make atonement” and adds “in service.”
